arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ اقتَرَبَ لِلنّاسِ حِسابُهُم وَهُم فى غَفلَةٍ مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona
translation: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness

arabic: ما يَأتيهِم مِن ذِكرٍ مِن رَبِّهِم مُحدَثٍ إِلَّا استَمَعوهُ وَهُم يَلعَبونَ
transliteration: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona
translation: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play

arabic: لاهِيَةً قُلوبُهُم وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجوَى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا هَل هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم أَفَتَأتونَ السِّحرَ وَأَنتُم تُبصِرونَ
transliteration: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona
translation: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)

arabic: قالَ رَبّى يَعلَمُ القَولَ فِى السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ وَهُوَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ
transliteration: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
translation: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower

arabic: بَل قالوا أَضغٰثُ أَحلٰمٍ بَلِ افتَرىٰهُ بَل هُوَ شاعِرٌ فَليَأتِنا بِـٔايَةٍ كَما أُرسِلَ الأَوَّلونَ
transliteration: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona
translation: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents)

arabic: ما ءامَنَت قَبلَهُم مِن قَريَةٍ أَهلَكنٰها أَفَهُم يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona
translation: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe

arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا قَبلَكَ إِلّا رِجالًا نوحى إِلَيهِم فَسـَٔلوا أَهلَ الذِّكرِ إِن كُنتُم لا تَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona
translation: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not

arabic: وَما جَعَلنٰهُم جَسَدًا لا يَأكُلونَ الطَّعامَ وَما كانوا خٰلِدينَ
transliteration: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena
translation: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals

arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقنٰهُمُ الوَعدَ فَأَنجَينٰهُم وَمَن نَشاءُ وَأَهلَكنَا المُسرِفينَ
transliteration: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena
translation: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals

arabic: لَقَد أَنزَلنا إِلَيكُم كِتٰبًا فيهِ ذِكرُكُم أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona
translation: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense

arabic: وَكَم قَصَمنا مِن قَريَةٍ كانَت ظالِمَةً وَأَنشَأنا بَعدَها قَومًا ءاخَرينَ
transliteration: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena
translation: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk

arabic: فَلَمّا أَحَسّوا بَأسَنا إِذا هُم مِنها يَركُضونَ
transliteration: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona
translation: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it

arabic: لا تَركُضوا وَارجِعوا إِلىٰ ما أُترِفتُم فيهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُم لَعَلَّكُم تُسـَٔلونَ
transliteration: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona
translation: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned

arabic: قالوا يٰوَيلَنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
translation: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers

arabic: فَما زالَت تِلكَ دَعوىٰهُم حَتّىٰ جَعَلنٰهُم حَصيدًا خٰمِدينَ
transliteration: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena
translation: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct

arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّماءَ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما لٰعِبينَ
transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
translation: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play

arabic: لَو أَرَدنا أَن نَتَّخِذَ لَهوًا لَاتَّخَذنٰهُ مِن لَدُنّا إِن كُنّا فٰعِلينَ
transliteration: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena
translation: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did

arabic: بَل نَقذِفُ بِالحَقِّ عَلَى البٰطِلِ فَيَدمَغُهُ فَإِذا هُوَ زاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ الوَيلُ مِمّا تَصِفونَ
transliteration: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona
translation: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

arabic: وَلَهُ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَمَن عِندَهُ لا يَستَكبِرونَ عَن عِبادَتِهِ وَلا يَستَحسِرونَ
transliteration: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona
translation: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary

arabic: يُسَبِّحونَ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ لا يَفتُرونَ
transliteration: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona
translation: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not

arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذوا ءالِهَةً مِنَ الأَرضِ هُم يُنشِرونَ
transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona
translation: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead

arabic: لَو كانَ فيهِما ءالِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتا فَسُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَرشِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
transliteration: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
translation: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him)

arabic: لا يُسـَٔلُ عَمّا يَفعَلُ وَهُم يُسـَٔلونَ
transliteration: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona
translation: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned

arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِهِ ءالِهَةً قُل هاتوا بُرهٰنَكُم هٰذا ذِكرُ مَن مَعِىَ وَذِكرُ مَن قَبلى بَل أَكثَرُهُم لا يَعلَمونَ الحَقَّ فَهُم مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona
translation: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse

arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا نوحى إِلَيهِ أَنَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنا۠ فَاعبُدونِ
transliteration: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni
translation: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me

arabic: وَقالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبحٰنَهُ بَل عِبادٌ مُكرَمونَ
transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona
translation: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves

arabic: لا يَسبِقونَهُ بِالقَولِ وَهُم بِأَمرِهِ يَعمَلونَ
transliteration: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona
translation: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command

arabic: يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم وَلا يَشفَعونَ إِلّا لِمَنِ ارتَضىٰ وَهُم مِن خَشيَتِهِ مُشفِقونَ
transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona
translation: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him

arabic: وَمَن يَقُل مِنهُم إِنّى إِلٰهٌ مِن دونِهِ فَذٰلِكَ نَجزيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجزِى الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena
translation: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers

arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ كانَتا رَتقًا فَفَتَقنٰهُما وَجَعَلنا مِنَ الماءِ كُلَّ شَيءٍ حَىٍّ أَفَلا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona
translation: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe

arabic: وَجَعَلنا فِى الأَرضِ رَوٰسِىَ أَن تَميدَ بِهِم وَجَعَلنا فيها فِجاجًا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّهُم يَهتَدونَ
transliteration: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona
translation: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way

arabic: وَجَعَلنَا السَّماءَ سَقفًا مَحفوظًا وَهُم عَن ءايٰتِها مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona
translation: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents

arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى خَلَقَ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ وَالشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فى فَلَكٍ يَسبَحونَ
transliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona
translation: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit

arabic: وَما جَعَلنا لِبَشَرٍ مِن قَبلِكَ الخُلدَ أَفَإِي۟ن مِتَّ فَهُمُ الخٰلِدونَ
transliteration: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona
translation: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal

arabic: كُلُّ نَفسٍ ذائِقَةُ المَوتِ وَنَبلوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالخَيرِ فِتنَةً وَإِلَينا تُرجَعونَ
transliteration: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona
translation: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned

arabic: وَإِذا رَءاكَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا إِن يَتَّخِذونَكَ إِلّا هُزُوًا أَهٰذَا الَّذى يَذكُرُ ءالِهَتَكُم وَهُم بِذِكرِ الرَّحمٰنِ هُم كٰفِرونَ
transliteration: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona
translation: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent

arabic: خُلِقَ الإِنسٰنُ مِن عَجَلٍ سَأُو۟ريكُم ءايٰتى فَلا تَستَعجِلونِ
transliteration: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona
translation: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten

arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
translation: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

arabic: لَو يَعلَمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا حينَ لا يَكُفّونَ عَن وُجوهِهِمُ النّارَ وَلا عَن ظُهورِهِم وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
transliteration: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona
translation: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped

arabic: بَل تَأتيهِم بَغتَةً فَتَبهَتُهُم فَلا يَستَطيعونَ رَدَّها وَلا هُم يُنظَرونَ
transliteration: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona
translation: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved

arabic: وَلَقَدِ استُهزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِن قَبلِكَ فَحاقَ بِالَّذينَ سَخِروا مِنهُم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
transliteration: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
translation: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them

arabic: قُل مَن يَكلَؤُكُم بِالَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ بَل هُم عَن ذِكرِ رَبِّهِم مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona
translation: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord

arabic: أَم لَهُم ءالِهَةٌ تَمنَعُهُم مِن دونِنا لا يَستَطيعونَ نَصرَ أَنفُسِهِم وَلا هُم مِنّا يُصحَبونَ
transliteration: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona
translation: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us

arabic: بَل مَتَّعنا هٰؤُلاءِ وَءاباءَهُم حَتّىٰ طالَ عَلَيهِمُ العُمُرُ أَفَلا يَرَونَ أَنّا نَأتِى الأَرضَ نَنقُصُها مِن أَطرافِها أَفَهُمُ الغٰلِبونَ
transliteration: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona
translation: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors

arabic: قُل إِنَّما أُنذِرُكُم بِالوَحىِ وَلا يَسمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعاءَ إِذا ما يُنذَرونَ
transliteration: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona
translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned

arabic: وَلَئِن مَسَّتهُم نَفحَةٌ مِن عَذابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقولُنَّ يٰوَيلَنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
translation: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers

arabic: وَنَضَعُ المَوٰزينَ القِسطَ لِيَومِ القِيٰمَةِ فَلا تُظلَمُ نَفسٌ شَيـًٔا وَإِن كانَ مِثقالَ حَبَّةٍ مِن خَردَلٍ أَتَينا بِها وَكَفىٰ بِنا حٰسِبينَ
transliteration: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena
translation: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners

arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا موسىٰ وَهٰرونَ الفُرقانَ وَضِياءً وَذِكرًا لِلمُتَّقينَ
transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena
translation: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil

arabic: الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم بِالغَيبِ وَهُم مِنَ السّاعَةِ مُشفِقونَ
transliteration: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona
translation: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom)

arabic: وَهٰذا ذِكرٌ مُبارَكٌ أَنزَلنٰهُ أَفَأَنتُم لَهُ مُنكِرونَ
transliteration: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona
translation: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it

arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا إِبرٰهيمَ رُشدَهُ مِن قَبلُ وَكُنّا بِهِ عٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena
translation: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him

arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ما هٰذِهِ التَّماثيلُ الَّتى أَنتُم لَها عٰكِفونَ
transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona
translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion

arabic: قالوا وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا لَها عٰبِدينَ
transliteration: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena
translation: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them

arabic: قالَ لَقَد كُنتُم أَنتُم وَءاباؤُكُم فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin
translation: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error

arabic: قالوا أَجِئتَنا بِالحَقِّ أَم أَنتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبينَ
transliteration: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena
translation: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester

arabic: قالَ بَل رَبُّكُم رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ الَّذى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنا۠ عَلىٰ ذٰلِكُم مِنَ الشّٰهِدينَ
transliteration: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena
translation: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that

arabic: وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكيدَنَّ أَصنٰمَكُم بَعدَ أَن تُوَلّوا مُدبِرينَ
transliteration: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena
translation: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs

arabic: فَجَعَلَهُم جُذٰذًا إِلّا كَبيرًا لَهُم لَعَلَّهُم إِلَيهِ يَرجِعونَ
transliteration: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona
translation: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it

arabic: قالوا مَن فَعَلَ هٰذا بِـٔالِهَتِنا إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena
translation: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer

arabic: قالوا سَمِعنا فَتًى يَذكُرُهُم يُقالُ لَهُ إِبرٰهيمُ
transliteration: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu
translation: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham

arabic: قالوا فَأتوا بِهِ عَلىٰ أَعيُنِ النّاسِ لَعَلَّهُم يَشهَدونَ
transliteration: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona
translation: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify

arabic: قالوا ءَأَنتَ فَعَلتَ هٰذا بِـٔالِهَتِنا يٰإِبرٰهيمُ
transliteration: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu
translation: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham

arabic: قالَ بَل فَعَلَهُ كَبيرُهُم هٰذا فَسـَٔلوهُم إِن كانوا يَنطِقونَ
transliteration: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona
translation: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak

arabic: فَرَجَعوا إِلىٰ أَنفُسِهِم فَقالوا إِنَّكُم أَنتُمُ الظّٰلِمونَ
transliteration: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona
translation: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers

arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسوا عَلىٰ رُءوسِهِم لَقَد عَلِمتَ ما هٰؤُلاءِ يَنطِقونَ
transliteration: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona
translation: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not

arabic: قالَ أَفَتَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَنفَعُكُم شَيـًٔا وَلا يَضُرُّكُم
transliteration: Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum
translation: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you

arabic: أُفٍّ لَكُم وَلِما تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona
translation: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense

arabic: قالوا حَرِّقوهُ وَانصُروا ءالِهَتَكُم إِن كُنتُم فٰعِلينَ
transliteration: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena
translation: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing

arabic: قُلنا يٰنارُ كونى بَردًا وَسَلٰمًا عَلىٰ إِبرٰهيمَ
transliteration: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema
translation: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham

arabic: وَأَرادوا بِهِ كَيدًا فَجَعَلنٰهُمُ الأَخسَرينَ
transliteration: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena
translation: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers

arabic: وَنَجَّينٰهُ وَلوطًا إِلَى الأَرضِ الَّتى بٰرَكنا فيها لِلعٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena
translation: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples

arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ إِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ نافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلنا صٰلِحينَ
transliteration: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena
translation: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous

arabic: وَجَعَلنٰهُم أَئِمَّةً يَهدونَ بِأَمرِنا وَأَوحَينا إِلَيهِم فِعلَ الخَيرٰتِ وَإِقامَ الصَّلوٰةِ وَإيتاءَ الزَّكوٰةِ وَكانوا لَنا عٰبِدينَ
transliteration: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena
translation: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone)

arabic: وَلوطًا ءاتَينٰهُ حُكمًا وَعِلمًا وَنَجَّينٰهُ مِنَ القَريَةِ الَّتى كانَت تَعمَلُ الخَبٰئِثَ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومَ سَوءٍ فٰسِقينَ
transliteration: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena
translation: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd

arabic: وَأَدخَلنٰهُ فى رَحمَتِنا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصّٰلِحينَ
transliteration: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena
translation: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous

arabic: وَنوحًا إِذ نادىٰ مِن قَبلُ فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ فَنَجَّينٰهُ وَأَهلَهُ مِنَ الكَربِ العَظيمِ
transliteration: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
translation: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction

arabic: وَنَصَرنٰهُ مِنَ القَومِ الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومَ سَوءٍ فَأَغرَقنٰهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
translation: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all

arabic: وَداوۥدَ وَسُلَيمٰنَ إِذ يَحكُمانِ فِى الحَرثِ إِذ نَفَشَت فيهِ غَنَمُ القَومِ وَكُنّا لِحُكمِهِم شٰهِدينَ
transliteration: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena
translation: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment

arabic: فَفَهَّمنٰها سُلَيمٰنَ وَكُلًّا ءاتَينا حُكمًا وَعِلمًا وَسَخَّرنا مَعَ داوۥدَ الجِبالَ يُسَبِّحنَ وَالطَّيرَ وَكُنّا فٰعِلينَ
transliteration: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena
translation: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof)

arabic: وَعَلَّمنٰهُ صَنعَةَ لَبوسٍ لَكُم لِتُحصِنَكُم مِن بَأسِكُم فَهَل أَنتُم شٰكِرونَ
transliteration: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona
translation: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful

arabic: وَلِسُلَيمٰنَ الرّيحَ عاصِفَةً تَجرى بِأَمرِهِ إِلَى الأَرضِ الَّتى بٰرَكنا فيها وَكُنّا بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena
translation: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware

arabic: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطينِ مَن يَغوصونَ لَهُ وَيَعمَلونَ عَمَلًا دونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنّا لَهُم حٰفِظينَ
transliteration: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena
translation: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them

arabic: وَأَيّوبَ إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَسَّنِىَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرحَمُ الرّٰحِمينَ
transliteration: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena
translation: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy

arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ فَكَشَفنا ما بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ وَءاتَينٰهُ أَهلَهُ وَمِثلَهُم مَعَهُم رَحمَةً مِن عِندِنا وَذِكرىٰ لِلعٰبِدينَ
transliteration: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena
translation: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers

arabic: وَإِسمٰعيلَ وَإِدريسَ وَذَا الكِفلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصّٰبِرينَ
transliteration: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena
translation: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast

arabic: وَأَدخَلنٰهُم فى رَحمَتِنا إِنَّهُم مِنَ الصّٰلِحينَ
transliteration: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena
translation: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous

arabic: وَذَا النّونِ إِذ ذَهَبَ مُغٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَن نَقدِرَ عَلَيهِ فَنادىٰ فِى الظُّلُمٰتِ أَن لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنتَ سُبحٰنَكَ إِنّى كُنتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena
translation: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ وَنَجَّينٰهُ مِنَ الغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُۨجِى المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena
translation: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers

arabic: وَزَكَرِيّا إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لا تَذَرنى فَردًا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الوٰرِثينَ
transliteration: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena
translation: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors

arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ وَوَهَبنا لَهُ يَحيىٰ وَأَصلَحنا لَهُ زَوجَهُ إِنَّهُم كانوا يُسٰرِعونَ فِى الخَيرٰتِ وَيَدعونَنا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكانوا لَنا خٰشِعينَ
transliteration: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena
translation: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us

arabic: وَالَّتى أَحصَنَت فَرجَها فَنَفَخنا فيها مِن روحِنا وَجَعَلنٰها وَابنَها ءايَةً لِلعٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena
translation: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُم أُمَّةً وٰحِدَةً وَأَنا۠ رَبُّكُم فَاعبُدونِ
transliteration: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni
translation: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

arabic: وَتَقَطَّعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم كُلٌّ إِلَينا رٰجِعونَ
transliteration: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona
translation: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us

arabic: فَمَن يَعمَل مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤمِنٌ فَلا كُفرانَ لِسَعيِهِ وَإِنّا لَهُ كٰتِبونَ
transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona
translation: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him

arabic: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلىٰ قَريَةٍ أَهلَكنٰها أَنَّهُم لا يَرجِعونَ
transliteration: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona
translation: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return

arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا فُتِحَت يَأجوجُ وَمَأجوجُ وَهُم مِن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلونَ
transliteration: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona
translation: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound

arabic: وَاقتَرَبَ الوَعدُ الحَقُّ فَإِذا هِىَ شٰخِصَةٌ أَبصٰرُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا يٰوَيلَنا قَد كُنّا فى غَفلَةٍ مِن هٰذا بَل كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena
translation: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers

arabic: إِنَّكُم وَما تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُم لَها وٰرِدونَ
transliteration: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona
translation: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come

arabic: لَو كانَ هٰؤُلاءِ ءالِهَةً ما وَرَدوها وَكُلٌّ فيها خٰلِدونَ
transliteration: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona
translation: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein

arabic: لَهُم فيها زَفيرٌ وَهُم فيها لا يَسمَعونَ
transliteration: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona
translation: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ سَبَقَت لَهُم مِنَّا الحُسنىٰ أُولٰئِكَ عَنها مُبعَدونَ
transliteration: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona
translation: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence

arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ حَسيسَها وَهُم فى مَا اشتَهَت أَنفُسُهُم خٰلِدونَ
transliteration: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona
translation: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire

arabic: لا يَحزُنُهُمُ الفَزَعُ الأَكبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّىٰهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ هٰذا يَومُكُمُ الَّذى كُنتُم توعَدونَ
transliteration: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona
translation: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised

arabic: يَومَ نَطوِى السَّماءَ كَطَىِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلكُتُبِ كَما بَدَأنا أَوَّلَ خَلقٍ نُعيدُهُ وَعدًا عَلَينا إِنّا كُنّا فٰعِلينَ
transliteration: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena
translation: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it

arabic: وَلَقَد كَتَبنا فِى الزَّبورِ مِن بَعدِ الذِّكرِ أَنَّ الأَرضَ يَرِثُها عِبادِىَ الصّٰلِحونَ
transliteration: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona
translation: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth

arabic: إِنَّ فى هٰذا لَبَلٰغًا لِقَومٍ عٰبِدينَ
transliteration: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena
translation: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout

arabic: وَما أَرسَلنٰكَ إِلّا رَحمَةً لِلعٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena
translation: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples

arabic: قُل إِنَّما يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ أَنَّما إِلٰهُكُم إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَهَل أَنتُم مُسلِمونَ
transliteration: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona
translation: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَقُل ءاذَنتُكُم عَلىٰ سَواءٍ وَإِن أَدرى أَقَريبٌ أَم بَعيدٌ ما توعَدونَ
transliteration: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona
translation: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised

arabic: إِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ الجَهرَ مِنَ القَولِ وَيَعلَمُ ما تَكتُمونَ
transliteration: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona
translation: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal

arabic: وَإِن أَدرى لَعَلَّهُ فِتنَةٌ لَكُم وَمَتٰعٌ إِلىٰ حينٍ
transliteration: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin
translation: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while

arabic: قٰلَ رَبِّ احكُم بِالحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحمٰنُ المُستَعانُ عَلىٰ ما تَصِفونَ
transliteration: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona
translation: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him)
